-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Hydra of Darkneros.png  |title= Demon Water Magic |kanji= 魔水魔法 |romaji= Masui Mahō |english= Devil Water Magic (VIZ)  |user= #Lolopechka }} {{Nihongo|Demon Water Magic|魔水魔法|Masui Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of Water Magic.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of water at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.{{Clr}}
